Kravas. ''[…]'' He was a squad commander on Four.''"
"''He's obviously fallen a great deal since then. He was a Sentry Corporal here on One.''"
"''No mystery there. He's lucky he wasn't killed years ago. One of the most unpleasant people I've ever met.|Hyne and Syril Karn, on Kravas Drezzer|audio=Hyne-Karn-Four-Kassa.flac|}} '''Kravas Drezzer''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team|law enforcement arm]] of [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] on the astronomical object [[Morlana Four|Four]] as a [[squad]] [[Commanding officer|commander]] and then on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]] as a [[Sentry Corporal]]. In [[5 BBY]], he and fellow [[Tac-Corpo|sentry guard]] [[Verlo Skiff]] ignored their duties and attended a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]], where they noticed the visitor [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]. They were annoyed when a [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]] went to Andor first and taunted the patron while he was there. The drunken Drezzer and Skiff then followed Andor out of the brothel and confronted him. The pair attempted to plunder their quarry of his [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], only for Andor to attack and overpower the two sentry guards. Skiff was [[Death|killed]] in the scuffle and Drezzer tried to negotiate with Andor, only to be shot dead himself. Afterwards, [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] made a report on the incident to [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]], who wished for it to be mocked up as an accident as the two sentry guards were flouting rules. ==Biography== ===Slacking off=== {{Quote|Is there something amusing?''"
"''What?''"
"''You keep looking over at me like there's something funny.''"
"''Definitely not.|Drezzer and Cassian Andor|}} During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Kravas Drezzer served in the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] (Pre-Mor) [[Law enforcement agency|corporate security force]], which operated from the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]], for many [[Standard year|years]]. The corpo was once a [[squad]] [[Commanding officer|commander]] on [[Morlana Four]] before eventually finding himself as a [[Sentry Corporal]] and [[Tac-Corpo|sentry guard]]{{InsiderCite|220|On Program}} back on Morlana One. [[File:GaniAndSentries.png|thumb|left|250px|Hostess Gani attempted to distract Drezzer and Skiff.]] In [[5 BBY]], Drezzer and fellow sentry guard [[Verlo Skiff]] were on shift when they decided to ignore their duties and go to an expensive [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in Morlana One's [[Leisure Zone]]. There the pair drank [[Revnog]] at the bar, waiting for one of the brothel hostesses to approach them, when the human [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] entered the establishment, getting a drink of his own from the [[alien]] bartender. After the bartender informed Andor that he paid at the end of his stay there, Drezzer [[eye]]d the new visitor and warned him not to pursue the alien, joking that she would send him home crying. The Sentry Corporal turned back to speak with Skiff when a [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]] entered the room and approached Andor. Annoyed about still having to wait for a hostess, Drezzer interrupted the hostess and Andor, arguing that he and Skiff had been there first. The hostess assured the two that hostess [[Gani]] would go to them, but Drezzer insisted that he did not want that host. The hostess told the sentry guard to behave, and he sarcastically conceded. Gani spoke to Drezzer and Skiff for a short moment before the corpo turned his gaze back on Andor, who looked back when his hostess left. Drezzer chose to take offense in the other patron looking over at him, taunting him with Skiff's backing. ===Picking the wrong fights=== [[File:KravasDrezzerBegs-Kassa.png|thumb|right|300px|Drezzer pleads for his life to Cassian Andor.]] {{Quote|Oh, no, you didn't park out past the causeway, did ya?''"
"''I sure hope not. That's off-limits to visitors. We'd have to fine you.''"
"''Yeah, I mean, you know about the visitor's curfew, right?''"
"''Yeah, we'd have to impound your ride.|Verlo Skiff and Drezzer confront Andor|}} After Andor finished his query with the hostess, he left the brothel. Drezzer and Skiff, both of whom were drunk, followed with the intent to harass their quarry and take his [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]. As Andor reached the plaza's edge, leading to a causeway, the pair called him to a stop and began reciting excuses to fine him. Drezzer pulled his [[blaster]] out, prompting his arrestee to raise his hands and declare he was carrying 300 credits. The Sentry Corporal remarked that it was almost the exact amount he needed and asked Andor to bring it. Drezzer and Skiff's new acquaintance made the sentry guards search him themselves, Skiff rummaging his coat for the credits while Drezzer hit him with the blaster. [[File:Andor1-Cassiankillsguard.png|thumb|left|350px|Drezzer is shot dead by Andor.]] Andor then headbutted Skiff and grabbed Drezzer's [[Limb|arm]] as he attempted to fire at his adversary. Andor punched him in the throat, tackled him to the ground, then bashed his gun arm until he lost grip on his blaster. Retrieving Drezzer's sidearm, Andor furiously yelled at him and ordered him to get Skiff up. The corpo consulted his colleague, only to find Verlo had been accidentally killed in the short scuffle. Although Andor declared he was faking it, Drezzer tearfully insisted he wasn't, shooting a furious gaze at the man. Drezzer's expression then changes, as he seemingly concocts a plan to exact vengeance against Verlo's killer. Pleading with Andor, Drezzer tells him they will report the incident together as an accident, and Verlo died by mistake after a misunderstanding. Unconvinced, Andor steps forward with zero hesitation and executes Drezzer with a headshot. With Drezzer and Skiff killed, [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] investigated the incident and made a report on the fight and what he knew of Andor. Karn presented the report to [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] of Pre-Mor, who recognized Drezzer's name and called him an unpleasant man, remarking that it was surprising that he had not died years ago. Acknowledging that Drezzer and Skiff were breaking multiple rules and had likely picked a fateful fight, Hyne ordered Karn to mark it up as an accident to brush over the rule flouting that the late corpos had been committing. However, the deputy inspector wished not to leave the case to rest, and tracked Andor to the planet [[Ferrix]], leading a squad on an unsuccessful attempt to apprehend Drezzer's killer.{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Oh, they're just sentry guards. They like to play at being cops. It's… It's annoying.|The hostess, on Drezzer and Skiff|}} [[File:DrezzerSkiff-Kassa.png|thumb|right|300px|Drezzer put on an air of confidence to intimidate others.]] A human male, Kravas Drezzer had [[Color|light]] skin, green eyes, and greying brown [[hair]] with a mustache. Although just a sentry guard, he liked acting like the law, attempting to intimidate Cassian Andor multiple times, with Hyne considering him a most unpleasant individual. The Sentry Corporal was repeatedly sarcastic to others like Andor and the hostess. When Verlo Skiff was killed, Drezzer sobbed and mourned his companion, though he offered to pass of his death as an accident, hoping to appease Andor. ==Equipment== Drezzer wore blue uniform and carried a [[blaster pistol]] with a [[scope]]. ==Behind the scenes== Kravas Drezzer first appeared in the [[Kassa (episode)|first episode]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Toby Haynes]] and released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} The character was portrayed by [[Lee Boardman]], with [[Erol Mehmet]] as his stunt double. His last name was not stated in the episode, but was mentioned in [[Aurebesh]] in Syril Karn's report, which Hyne reads on a [[datapad]]. "Kravas" was first showcased in promotional images released by [[The Walt Disney Company]] on [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]].{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/hqrzwxx6jr3q65j7q2b53|text=PGM-FF-000062|date=2022-08-22}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Kravas Drezzer}} *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{Imo}} *{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} {{Imo}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} {{Imo}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look|''Andor'': A Disney+ Day Special Look]] {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|PboKpnin_Wg|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (1:30)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer-disney}} *{{SWYouTube|9Y05Q3SGZwc|Inside Look of Episodes 1-3 | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/inside-look-of-episodes-1-3-andor}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-1-episode-guide|text="Kassa" Episode Guide | Andor}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-episode-1-kassa-highlights|text=''Andor'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from Episode 1, "Kassa"}} *{{ThisWeek|CwLRnbG42w0|Diego Luna Talks Andor, Exclusive High Republic Short, and More!|sw_url=video/diego-luna-talks-andor-exclusive-high-republic-short-and-more}} *{{SW|url=news/tony-gilroy-andor-season-1-interview|text=Tony Gilroy Breaks Down ''Andor'' Season 1}} {{Imo}} *{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} {{Imo}} *{{InsiderCite|220|On Program}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Kravas Drezzer |fr=Kravas Drezzer |ja=クラヴァス・ドレザー |ka=კრევას დრეზერი |nl=Kravas Drezzer |pl=Kravas Drezzer |frFA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Drezzer, Kravas}} [[Category:Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation employees]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
